depicts: Square selfie of a smiling young man in a dark cap and dark collared shirt, in front of orange sandstone canyon walls and a bright sky gap.
composition: Face centred-left, filling about the middle half of the frame; cap top close to upper third. Shoulders and shirt cut by the bottom edge. Canyon rock fills left and right; bright sky gap above.

scan_first_read: A friendly close-up of a smiling person in a cap against orange canyon rock: an outdoor portrait.
